question: How does the s020 pipeline's q0-best closure scale with density (N_dir, N_mag, N_phi) on seed 89?
hypothesis: Increasing density along each axis hierarchically closes q0-best toward truth.
narrative_md: Density sweep on seed 89 (after a bracket-padding fix that uncaps N_mag past LS-peak count). q0-best closes hierarchically: 50.4deg -> 15.2deg (omega-mag inside tube) -> 8.59deg (omega-dir density 300->2000) -> 7.86deg (phi 12->60), then hits an off-circle floor (~8deg) that grid densification cannot close (geometric, not discretization). Wall scales sub-linearly (factor 0.9). Framework reach is density-bounded, not structurally limited; motivates the s034 LM polish.
